restrictions: thinking is off by default via chat_template_kwargs; enabling it tripled output tokens and solved one fewer

price_card.source: measured on this deployment 2026-08-29 at the throughput knee

failure_classes: node containerd death lost 3 episodes in a separate pass; they were re-run and are not in this count

agentic-coding.suite: swebench-verified-24, first instance of each repository family plus the second for families with three or more, fixed before any run; 20 usable after dropping episodes lost to transport
agentic-coding.accounting_boundary: the twenty items that produced a usable episode; the attempts that ended with the gateway returning 200 and an empty stream are excluded and are priced by reliability.mean_sunk_usd instead

tool-agent-user-retail.suite: tau-bench retail, the authors' tasks_dev split, all 20, one trial each
tool-agent-user-retail.accounting_boundary: the agent's own tokens on all 20 tasks. The user simulator is the same model on every arm, so its spend is a constant of the experiment and is not charged to the tier; no task ended on transport, so nothing is excluded here

notes: reusable cache measured at 7-14% of the engine's advertised kv_cache_size_tokens
the engine's kv_cache_usage_perc gauge reflects running requests only and is not a cache-occupancy alarm
